bias.zh: 反弹失败 · 跌破 $57–58，在 $54.6 上方超卖

read.en: Intel fell 7.0% on Nov 16 to $55.47, trading $54.90–57.20 on light volume (0.69x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($59.4), 10-day ($58.4), 30-day ($81.8), 100-day ($97.4) and 200-day ($87.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram almost closed; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($73.04), and RSI is 29.9, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月16日下跌 7.0%，收于 $55.47，盘中区间 $54.90–57.20，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.69 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$59.4）、10 日（$58.4）、30 日（$81.8）、100 日（$97.4）和 200 日均线（$87.4）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图几乎收拢；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$73.04），RSI 为 29.9，处于超卖。

read.en: The drop broke the $56.8–58.8 supports (Nov 4, 10 and 13 lows, 10-day), now resistance; the $54.90 low held above the Nov 6 low ($54.56). Resistance is $56.8–57.3, then $58.1–59.4 (Nov 10 close, 10 and 5-day) and $61.2–62.8. Support is $54.6–54.9, then $52.25 (Nov 5 close) and $51.5 (Nov 5 low). A close above $57.3 would target $58–59.4; below $54.6, $51.5–52.3.

r.en: Nov 4 low $56.77, Nov 10 low $56.85 and Nov 13 low $57.00, lost; Nov 16 high $57.20
Nov 12 close $61.20; Nov 11 close $62.50; Nov 12 high $62.76
